proposal.observation: Na-ion physics pre-checks (loss.md §4.8): near-linear capacity fade is the supported law (b median 1.05, corr(observed fade 10-100, true fade rate) 0.95-0.96); CE, hysteresis and C-rate rules are sub-resolution or contradicted. The learned-b law (NA-E025-E028) improved accuracy but not law consistency. Parent held-out fixed-b (threshold 0.8) law-fit error 0.0707 / 0.0405 / 0.0506 (mean 0.0539).
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Constraining the predicted EOL with the measured Na-ion fade law (b fixed to 1, threshold 0.8, no law head; train trajectories only) makes the prediction consistent with the physical fade law (held-out fixed-b law-fit error -20%) without worsening MAPE.
proposal.question_inherited: Does a stricter, Na-ion-specific law succeed where the learned-b law only regularised accuracy?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Gate stuck at init; late-prefix MAPE 0.10-0.12 on split 2021 while the extrapolation alone reaches 0.04-0.05 there.
proposal.why_this_experiment: User 2026-11-09: find physics suited to the Na dataset and register it in loss.md (done, §4.8, Codex APPROVE). N1 is tested first per the review.
proposal.modification: Loss = Relative Huber(0.15) + lambda * L_N1, L_N1 = mean_k |q_ref - (q_ref - 0.8) n_k / y_hat - q(n_k)| / (q_ref - 0.8) (loss.md §4.8 N1), rho 1.0 (the setting that kept balance PASS in NA-E026-E028), lambda calibrated per §5.2. Split 2021, seed 2021.
proposal.held_constant_components: NA-E009 model and config, split 2021, seed 2021, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/RMSE/Acc@15 vs NA-E009; held-out fixed-b (threshold 0.8) law-fit error vs parent 0.0707; balance R, cosine, active fraction; N1 train coverage.
proposal.rejection_condition: 3-split rule fixed before running (judged after NA-E034): KEEP N1 only if (i) 3-split mean MAPE <= 0.1137 (parent 0.1087 + 0.005), (ii) 3-split mean held-out fixed-b law-fit error (LAW_FIXED_B=1 tools/law_fit_eval.py: b = 1, threshold 0.8, eligible val cells = smoothed 0.8 crossing; parent 0.0707 / 0.0405 / 0.0506, mean 0.0539) falls >= 20% vs the parent (i.e. <= 0.0431), and (iii) balance PASS on every split. Otherwise DISCARD. Coverage: N1 supervises train cells with a smoothed 0.8 crossing (15/20, 18/20, 16/20); eligible val cells 6/6, 4/6, 6/6.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; NaFadeNet block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.
